title: The Family / The Fellowship network in government

tellings.quote: you look into this organization called The Family, The Fellowship, they were founded in the '30s and really took off in the post-war era.

plain: An organization called The Family, also known as The Fellowship, was founded in the 1930s and grew into an influential network in Washington after the Second World War, according to the researcher Jason Simosa. He tells Jesse Michels this from his own reading, leaning on the journalist Jeff Sharlet and a figure named Alonzo McDonald, and ties it to an alleged 1930s plot against President Franklin Roosevelt. He raises it as part of his case that a quiet network of powerful people sits behind official secrecy, including on UFOs.
